artDirection.name: EVO Quiet Premium 2.0
artDirection.concept: A single editorial beauty campaign derived from EVO brand anchors and rebuilt into a cleaner, calmer, more premium visual system.
artDirection.generationPolicy: Hero and navigation/service-category imagery are generated or art-directed into one campaign instead of directly inserting inconsistent source-feed photos.

typographyMood.hierarchy: strong contrast between display headings and functional UI copy

peoplePolicy: generic generated models are allowed for non-evidentiary service navigation
named EVO specialists must preserve real identity
generated people cannot be presented as real EVO staff

serviceGroupRules.semanticIntent: healthy styled hair, movement and shine
serviceGroupRules.scene: editorial three-quarter/back portrait emphasizing hair texture and motion
clean macro of hands with refined manicure against warm stone/cream
elegant seated lower-leg/foot composition with spa detail
clean specialist-tool detail with hygienic, clinical-beauty restraint
close beauty portrait focused on brows and symmetry
close portrait with refined lip/brow focus and artist-hand detail

serviceGroupRules.semanticIntent: skin quality, care and expert procedure
serviceGroupRules.scene: calm treatment close-up with gloved professional hands and luminous natural skin
clean device-treatment composition on leg/arm with soft premium lighting
minimal close-up of tattoo artist process with elegant composition
laser-device close-up with tattoo area, restrained clinical-beauty mood
minimal branded gift card/envelope composition with cream, olive and bronze materials

heroRules.semanticIntent: EVO as a complete beauty space, calm and premium
heroRules.scene: editorial female beauty portrait/environment hybrid with subtle cues to multi-service care, generous negative space for UI

specialistRules.treatment: normalize crop, background tone, white balance and contrast into the campaign system

portfolioRules.evidence: real sourced work only when presented as EVO work/result
portfolioRules.displayTreatment: unified crop, border, spacing and neutral grade without altering the result

forbiddenPatterns: same generic beauty portrait for unrelated categories
generated replacement face for a named specialist
